companies.title: Companies (tickers or CIKs)
companies.description: One or more tickers (AAPL) or CIK numbers (320193 / 0000320193).

concepts.title: Metrics (XBRL concepts)
concepts.description: us-gaap/dei concept names to include. Leave empty for a curated default set, or use ["all"] for every reported concept.

dateFrom.title: Period end from (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateFrom.description: Keep only datapoints whose period end is on/after this date.

dateTo.title: Period end to (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateTo.description: Keep only datapoints whose period end is on/before this date.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate to latest filing
dedupe.description: Keep the most recently filed value for each period (recommended for a clean time series).

userAgentEmail.title: Contact email for SEC User-Agent
userAgentEmail.description: SEC fair-access asks for a contact. Optional; a neutral default is used if blank.
